node_definition.done_when: A test with a temporary crew home delivers a run and reads its review dispatched with no coordinator call within one station tick. A second test delivers a run whose review stores no blocking finding and every score at or above the floor and reads it promoted and landed with no coordinator call. Negative control: at the base revision the second test reads that run unpromoted, waiting for a coordinator. The first test reads the review undispatched at the base revision when the reflex misses it; where the base revision already dispatches it, the first test is a regression guard and the record says so; the record is docs/evidence/fragments/work-flows-to-the-lane/s70.html. The tests run on all_debug.
node_definition.goal: dispatch a delivered run's review and promote a run whose review has no blocking finding with no coordinator call
